name: day-of-use
description: Twenty-four hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile, four times the window TandemKit's setup history load reads: meals and corrections from the pump's screen and from an app, an overnight 0% temp rate and a 120% one from an app, a 25-minute suspend for a cartridge change, a bolus stopped part-way, and a 2.0 U pump bolus 20 minutes ago. The history log holds about 290 BasalDelivery records, so a driver walks several 255-record slices to its start. With Control-IQ off the pump shows about 3.7 U IOB.
